Reimbursement (claim)
Money a person spent for work and asks to be paid back, raised on the Reimbursements page with receipts.
Non-Project Expense
The company-level expense a claim becomes once HR or Admin approves it. Paying it is what pays the claim back.
Pending Approval
A new claim, waiting for HR or Admin.
Requested / Pending L1 Approval
Approved by HR, but the person's claims this month reach ₹2,000, so an Admin (L1) must approve too.
CEO Pending
Approved by L1, but above ₹50,000, so it waits for the CEO.
Payment need to be paid
Fully approved (status Approved) and waiting for Accounts to send the money.
Reconciliation Pending
Accounts marked it paid; the bank reference (UTR) and proof are still to be added.
Reconciliation Done / Paid
UTR and proof added: the claim is Paid.
UTR
The bank's reference number for an online transfer.
Monthly limit (₹2,000)
For anyone: an approval that takes a person's month to ₹2,000 or more needs the L1 step. A warning, not a block.
PM monthly cap (₹2,000)
New in this PR: a Project Manager cannot raise more than ₹2,000 of claims in one calendar month. A block.
Badge
The number beside a tab's name.
Month bar
The bar above each tab's list: a month picker with tiles, and the totals by type (Travel, Food, Others).
Patch
A one-time database change that runs on bench migrate.
